subject: VM audit pack: scan rhythm, SLA affirmation & CVE closure plan

Subject: Request: VM cadence + SLA attestation for SOC 2 pack

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround earlier. Acme's compliance team is finalizing our SOC 2 supplemental evidence and our vendor security review specifically asked for:

- a succinct statement of Redwood's VM scan cadence (tech + infra components covered),
- the SLA/target windows for CVE remediation by severity, and
- a short attestation we can place in the audit packet confirming those processes are operational (we'll include it as an appendix).

Can you share the above plus any mapping to the SIG/CAIQ fields relating to VM and patching? Ideally a single zip or packet with a sample scan output that we can hand to our auditor.

Deadline: our auditor asked to receive the packet by EOD PT today. Is that feasible?

Best,
Maya Singh
Security Program Manager | Acme Corp
maya.singh@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@acme.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-12-01T09:35:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM cadence + SLA attestation for SOC 2 pack

Maya —

Thanks — we can absolutely get you an audit-ready pack by EOD PT. I'm attaching a short packet (VM cadence manifest + sample report) and a CSV that documents our SLA commitments by CVE severity. Highlights below so your auditor doesn't need to dig: 

- Scan cadence: infra-level authenticated vulnerability scans (weekly), container image scans (on CI build + daily registry sweep), and external/edge scans (weekly). We also run ad-hoc 24/7 scans triggered by public CVE disclosures that match our dependency inventory.

- Coverage: OS packages on dedicated hosts, container images (all images in production registries), orchestration plane components (K8s control plane nodes), third-party libs identified via SBOM, and exposed services.

- SLA (time-to-remediate target by severity):
  * Critical (active exploit/POC or RCE): 72 hours to ship mitigation/fix or documented compensating control; 7-day closure target for full remediation.
  * High: 14 days to remediation plan and patch or mitigant; 30-day closure target.
  * Medium: 30–90 days depending on risk/availability windows; prioritized in next monthly sprint.
  * Low: tracked in backlog with regular reconciliation each 90 days.

- Attestation: we include a signed attestation page in the packet confirming the above cadence and SLA process is owned by the Security & Infrastructure teams and executed as described.

Attachments included: redwood_vm_cadence_manifest.pdf, cve_remediation_sla_commitments.csv, SIG_SOC2_mapping_for_vm.xlsx, sample-weekly-scan-report.json

Jonas (security ops) and Lauren (GTM ops) are looped to confirm operational details below — Jonas can sign the attestation.

I'll follow up in one hour with the signed attestation PDF.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-12-01T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM cadence + SLA attestation for SOC 2 pack

Marissa / Maya —

Confirming operational details and signing authority: I'm the Security Ops manager for remediation workflows and I validate the SLA commitments in the attached CSV. A few operational clarifications for the auditor: 

1) Weekly authenticated scans: all production hosts are scanned with our agent-enabled scanner (credentials stored in KMS). Scan results are automatically ingested into our ticketing pipeline (Jira SUP-VM).
2) Registry sweeps: images failing critical/high checks are quarantined and flagged to the owning service team with a 24h mitigation expectation for criticals.
3) Public CVE response: we have a triage playbook that classifies exposures (Exploitability/Impact). For CVEs with public exploit code we escalate to a critical incident and follow the 72-hour mitigation pathway.
4) Exceptions: any exception to SLA is logged with compensating controls and a documented exception ticket (retained for audit).

I have prepared the attestation text and will sign it. Attestation excerpt (for your packet):

"Redwood Inference attests that vulnerability scanning, prioritization, and remediation are performed according to the cadence and SLA commitments set forth in the accompanying documents. Security Ops enforces remediation timelines via automated ticketing, and exceptions are documented and retained for audit review."

I'll attach the signed attestation PDF in the next message (Jonas Weber, Security Ops).

--
Jonas Weber
Security Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
